inventory_subtitle: Count products and confirm physical stock.
receive_plan_hint: Quantities contain the remaining saved plan: planned minus already received. Adjust them to actual production; zero skips a line.
saved_all: Saved successfully. Accepted lines are locked against another submission.
partial_result: Partially saved. Check each product result. Successful lines will not be submitted again.
conflict: Data changed while you were working. Reload and count the product again.
retry_hint: Result not confirmed. Retry saving; the same operation identifier will be used.
invalid_input: Enter valid quantities for the selected products.
failed: Could not save. Reload data and try again.
title: Product stock
subtitle: Count products manually and save actual quantities.
snapshot_hint: The list shows stock when opened. Only products with a confirmed nonzero balance are visible by default. Confirming a count means the indicated quantities have been physically counted.
unit_hint: Enter whole-product equivalents, e.g. 2 halves = 1 product. An empty field is not zero. Reservations are not deducted from the physical count.
shift_required: Select the employee using this tablet before saving stock.
unavailable: Could not load stock. Reload data.
unsupported: Weighted products are not supported yet.
empty: No products assigned to this shop.
hidden_hint: Zero and uncounted products hidden by default
show_all_hint: Use the switch below to show the full list and start the first count.
waste_reasons_unavailable: Waste reasons could not be loaded. Saving is disabled.
waste_default_hint: Only products with a confirmed positive balance are shown by default.
waste_unsupported: This product is not supported: waste can only be reported for whole, non-divisible pieces.
waste_uninitialized: Set the product stock first in the Stock tab.
waste_zero: There is no positive stock to report as waste.
waste_no_reportable: There are no products with a confirmed positive balance.
waste_empty: No products have been added yet.
waste_history_unavailable: Today's history could not be loaded.
waste_history_empty: No waste has been reported today.
waste_comment_hint: A note is required for the other reason.
waste_invalid_line: Enter a positive whole-piece quantity no greater than current stock; add a note when required.
waste_invalid_report: Complete every report line correctly. No line will be silently omitted.
waste_conflict: Stock changed while you were working. Data was refreshed; review quantities and save again.
waste_failed: Waste could not be saved. The draft remains on screen.
waste_network: Saving was not confirmed. The draft was kept — retry without changing it.
waste_saved_warning: Waste saved. Reservations are now short by: %s pcs.
carryover_subtitle: Assess what remains for the next day and what must be discarded.
carryover_unavailable: The settlement sheet could not be loaded.
carryover_date_hint: Dates use the shop time zone. Leaving stock for tomorrow does not increase stock or production.
carryover_unsupported: This product is not supported: settlement is only for whole, non-divisible pieces.
carryover_reassess: Stock changed. Assess this line again.
carryover_changed_after: Stock changed after settlement; the amount left for tomorrow is not current stock.
carryover_summary_text: Left for %date%: %carry% pcs. To discard: %waste% pcs.
carryover_invalid: Confirm every product and ensure tomorrow plus discard quantities equal stock.
carryover_conflict: The sheet or stock changed. Data was refreshed; reassess marked lines.
carryover_failed: Settlement could not be approved. The draft remains on screen.
carryover_network: Saving was not confirmed. The draft was kept — retry without changes.
carryover_saved_warning: Settlement saved. Reservations are now short by: %s pcs.
carryover_previous_empty: There are no recorded leftovers from the previous day.
